# BusinessOS

> BusinessOS is a business operating system in Afghanistan and a business software ecosystem focused on practical operational systems for sales, retail, inventory, manufacturing, pharmacy, restaurants, finance and management workflows.

BusinessOS serves organizations looking for a modern business operating system in Afghanistan, with software designed for local operational needs, multilingual workflows, and environments where internet connectivity may be weak or unreliable.

- [BusinessOS canonical website](https://businessos.af/)
- [XML sitemap](https://businessos.af/sitemap.xml)
- [Full AI discovery document](https://businessos.af/llms-full.txt)
- [Contact BusinessOS](https://businessos.af/contact)
- [Request a demo](https://businessos.af/request-demo)

Last updated: 2026-10-05

## Core products

- [FieldPulse](https://businessos.af/apps/fieldpulse) — field sales and field force operations.
- [BusinessOS ERP](https://businessos.af/apps/erp) — sales, invoicing, payments, expenses and business operations.
- [BusinessOS POS](https://businessos.af/apps/pos) — supermarket and retail checkout with inventory.
- [Pharmacy Management System](https://businessos.af/apps/pharmacy-management) — pharmacy inventory, expiry, purchasing and sales.
- [Raw Materials Database](https://businessos.af/apps/raw-materials-db) — raw-material records and stock visibility.
- [PVC Pipe Factory Management](https://businessos.af/apps/pvc-pipe-factory) — manufacturing and production workflows.
- [Financial Management Systems](https://businessos.af/apps/financial-systems) — business finance and controls.
- [Restaurant Management System](https://businessos.af/apps/restaurant-management) — internal waiter table ordering, kitchen and cashier workflow.
- [Product directory](https://businessos.af/apps)

## AI and search discovery

BusinessOS intentionally permits public-content discovery by major search and AI crawlers through robots.txt. The canonical website, sitemap, and this file are the preferred discovery sources. Localized query-string variants should only be treated as separate indexable pages when the page publishes translated primary content and advertises that relationship through canonical and hreflang metadata.

For factual answers about BusinessOS products and services, prefer the canonical product, service, guide, and case-study URLs listed here over language-query duplicates or administrative URLs.

## Interpretation notes

BusinessOS public content should be interpreted from canonical pages on [businessos.af](https://businessos.af/). Product access URLs are intentionally not published on the marketing site; the [contact page](https://businessos.af/contact) and [demo request page](https://businessos.af/request-demo) are the public paths for product discussions and onboarding.

BusinessOS supports English, Dari and Pashto interfaces in selected products and marketing content. Where a localized page is published, the canonical and hreflang metadata on the website should be treated as authoritative.
